<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex013012025-05-2117-53-13" status="reviewed" part="M" next="ex1301_1282023-4">
         <milestone unit="section" n="Introductory verses (1b1-1b5"/> 
        <milestone unit="section" n="v. 1"/> 
        <lg> <l>gang zhig nyes pa kun bral chos rnams la ||</l><l>ye shes spyan <choice><reg>dang</reg><orig>dang {ldan pa'}</orig></choice>  thugs rje'i gsung dbyangs kyis ||</l><l>legs 'dod skye bo don la mi slu ba'i ||</l><l>'jug yul <rs type="deity">ston pa</rs> <lb n="1b2"/> de la phyag 'tshal lo ||</l></lg>
        <note type="translation">I bow down to the one who teaches the object of engagement that is non-erroneous with regard to the goal of people who wish well,
         Through the melodious voice of compassion,
         With the eye of wisdom on the phenomena free from all faults.</note>

  <seg type="excerpt" xml:id="ex1301_1282023-4" status="reviewed" part="M" next="ex13012023-07-2008-36-52">
<milestone unit="section" n="v. 2"/> 
       <lg><l>gang ma mthong pas srid par 'khyams gyur pa ||</l> <l>bdag la shes bya'i gnas la gnas nyid bzhin ||</l> <l>lta byed tshad ma'i myig gnyis sbyin mdzad pa'i ||</l>
            <l>rgyal mtshungs <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">bla ma rnams</rs> la phyag 'tshal lo ||</l></lg>
         <note type="translation">I bow down to the bla mas, who are worthy of the Victorious ones,
Who bestowed the two eyes of valid cognition that make me,
Who is roaming in saṃsāra due to not seing it,
See the nature of objects of cognition as they are.
</note></seg>
<milestone unit="section" n="v. 3"/> 
         <seg type="excerpt" xml:id="ex13012023-07-2008-36-52" status="reviewed" part="M" next="ex01301_2025-11-2609-41-61"> <lg><l>gang zhig dngos stobs blo yis dngos rnams la ||</l> <l>log lta'i gzhung rnams rab 'jig dngos nyid dang ||</l> <l><lb n="1b3"/> <rs type="deity">ston pa</rs>'i gsung don nges byed rigs pa'i tshul ||</l> <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3773"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3774">rnam nges</rs> mdzad pa</rs> de 'dir rgyal gyur cig ||</l></lg>
            <note type="translation">May the one who composed the Pramāṇaviniścaya be here victorious!
[The Pramāṇaviniścaya] that completely destroys the traditions of false views about entities 
By a mind based on the force of reality, 
The method of reasoning that ascertains reality and the meaning of the Teacher's words.
(Alternatively: May the one, who composed [the Pramāṇaviniścaya] ascertaining  
Reality completely destroying texts with false views about entities and, 
The method of reasoning determining the meaning of Teacher’s words 
Through the mind with the power of reality here, be victorious!)
</note></seg>
        <seg type="shared" xml:id="ex01301_2025-11-2609-41-61" status="reviewed" part="M" next="ex1301_10202023-06-285"/><milestone unit="section" n="v. 4"/> 
        <lg> <l>de lta'i gzhung 'di skye bo blo gros phyogs can gyis ||</l><l>
        tshig don ma bshad tshig dang don 'ga' bshad pa dang |</l> <l>log par bshad dang skabs don gzhung las 'khyams bshad kyis ||</l> <l>shes 'dod rnams kyi dus dang sgra blo gron gyur byas ||</l></lg><note type="translation">(Regarding) such a treatise, those of biaised understanding, 
Made those who whish to know waste their time, speech, and intellignece
By not explaining the meaning of words, explaining words and meaning partially,
Explaining them incorrectly, or explaining the contextual meaning in a way that deviates from the treatise.
</note> </seg></TEI>
